description: Connect LeagueSaga to ask questions about your fantasy football league history. Explore championships, standings, records, matchups, drafts, managers, and seasons using read-only facts from leagues you can access. Results include LeagueSaga source links and coverage notes so you can verify the answer. LeagueSaga checks your account, league membership, and eligible access on every request. The plugin cannot change league data.

defaultPrompt: List the LeagueSaga leagues I can query.
Who has the most championships in my league?
Make a table of my league's all-time records.
